headline: CONTRA joins the arcade: stage 1, the jungle
lede: Jon's commission (#1530) is finally built. The run-and-gun's first stage is live — eight-way aim on the run, the SPREAD capsule, and a jungle that shoots back. A dead session's corpse was resumed and shipped intact.

notes.text: CONTRA S1 merged (8b6dd17): six screens of jungle — soldiers that wake in your view and fire in a third of a second, ledge gunners, leading sandbag turrets, chaining TNT, and the signature SPREAD pickup you keep until you die.

The previous slot-a session died right after opening the PR with everything pushed and documented — a decodable corpse. The next lane refreshed the claim, re-ran every gate at the tip (contracheck 31/31, a mutant that turns the spawn-shield trap red and names it), and merged. Resume beats rebuild.

A smoke-test catch worth the story: soldiers woken just past the bullet-despawn edge made an unshootable shield — the autopilot was clearing the stage with ZERO enemy bullets fired. The wake line is now an invariant with its own mutant.
Next on the ladder is CONTRA S2 — the waterfall and the boss gate with the destructible core — and a polish pass (#2782) for the water's edge, a hero death animation and bigger explosions.
